meta.title: Lantai core memory
meta.description: Manage automatic loading in DSH General settings. Off by default. Conversations in configured folders use an encrypted connection to load rules (policy), personal information (identity), and any explicitly configured task progress. Memory is sent to the model and recorded in chat history. Turning it off keeps existing history.

client.title: Load Lantai memory automatically
client.description: Applies to conversations in configured folders. Memory is sent to the model and may be visible to anyone who can view the conversation. Turning it off keeps existing history.
client.scopeWithTask: Rules, personal information, and configured task progress
client.scopeChanged: The memory scope changed. Automatic loading is off.
client.readOnly: This setting cannot be changed right now.
client.storageUnavailable: The setting could not be confirmed. Memory reads are paused.
client.enableUnconfirmed: Could not confirm that memory was enabled.
client.stopUnconfirmed: Turning memory off could not be confirmed.
